name: release-readiness-calibration
description: Calibration eval for judge-release-readiness. Runs release-readiness-classify against the labeled release-readiness-calibration dataset and scores the emitted verdict EXACTLY against the human label. Pass rate = go/no-go accuracy; the per-row drilldown shows exactly which releases the judge mis-calls (and in which direction — shipping on gappy evidence vs. holding well-evidenced releases), which is what you tune the rubric against. Run it from the Evals page, or replay the dataset through /api/runs/start.
